rateNotes.city: Tarif Dalam Kota 12 jam di atas berlaku untuk Jabodetabek, sudah termasuk jasa driver; belum termasuk BBM, tol, parkir, dan makan driver (Rp100.000/hari). Tarif untuk kota lain dikonfirmasi admin.
rateNotes.allIn: Tarif All-in di atas untuk pemakaian dalam kota Jakarta selama 12 jam, sudah termasuk BBM, tol, dan makan driver; belum termasuk parkir dan tiket masuk wisata. Paket Fullday (06.00–23.00), kota lain, dan perjalanan luar kota dikonfirmasi admin. Kelebihan jam dikenakan 10% dari tarif Fullday per jam. Kapasitas penumpang sudah termasuk jasa driver.

rateNotesEn.city: The in-town rate covers 12 hours with the car and driver in Greater Jakarta. Fuel, tolls, parking and the driver's meals (Rp100,000 a day) are paid separately. Rates for other cities are confirmed by our team.
rateNotesEn.allIn: The all-in rate is for 12 hours within Jakarta and includes fuel, tolls and the driver's meals; parking and entrance tickets are extra. Full-day hire (06:00 to 23:00), other cities and out-of-town trips are confirmed by our team. Extra hours cost 10% of the full-day rate per hour. Seat numbers include the driver.
